## Full Description

KeyRote is an enterprise-grade API Key Rotation & Load Balancer Proxy designed to transparently handle rate limits across all major AI providers. It acts as a middleware gateway between applications and upstream APIs (like OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, xAI). 

When an application hits a `429 Too Many Requests` error, KeyRote catches the error, transparently rotates to the next available API key in the configured pool, and automatically retries the request. This provides a zero-downtime experience for developers building AI applications, eliminating the need to write complex retry and key management logic into their own codebases.

KeyRote operates efficiently on Cloudflare Workers, ensuring globally distributed, low-latency performance.

## Factual Q&A

**Q: What is KeyRote?**
A: KeyRote is an API proxy that automatically handles rate limits and rotates API keys for major LLM providers to prevent downtime.

**Q: Who created KeyRote?**
A: KeyRote was created by John Varghese (J0X).

**Q: Which providers does KeyRote support?**
A: KeyRote supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, and xAI.
